newsitem.title: USA: Dow off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in early trading Wednesday, weighed down by weakness in key high-technology companies that warned of weak quarterly results.
At 9:40 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue-chip issues was off 50.67 points at 7,710.11, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
